lanes.native: bun <seed> <wrapper.bend> -o <bin>, then <bin>: the clang lane C1 is built on

fields.meaning: Fielded constructors, flat field patterns and quantities, checked and evaluated.

recursion.meaning: First-parameter structural self-calls in the checker and evaluator.

layout.meaning: Newlines, blank lines and comment lines at continuation points inside (), {}, [] and multi-line def parameter lists.

catalog.meaning: Catalog limits of 4,096 functions and 1,024 types per book.

spine.meaning: A declaration spine whose parser depth measures nesting, not the declaration count (SCALE-12), in every CLI including eval-cli.

base.meaning: Loading the pinned Base and lowering its reachable slice.

modules.meaning: Local ./x.bend imports, qualified names and qualified constructors.

packages.meaning: Hash-pinned package imports (0x<hash>/bytes.bend) from a frozen bundle.

nest.meaning: Multi-scrutinee matches, nested and wildcard patterns, first-match rows.

literals.meaning: U32, Nat, Char and String literals and the Base primitive intrinsics.

nat-columns.meaning: Nat literal, successor and wildcard patterns as columns of the one pattern matrix.

nat-word.meaning: A Nat representation in which 1,048,576-scale conversions fit the evaluator budget.

u32-bits.meaning: U32.or, U32.xor and U32.not as intrinsics (WOr, WXor, WNot).

generics.meaning: Generic datatypes and defs, erased type parameters, quantity arguments.

closures.meaning: Lambdas, captures, arrow-typed parameters and function values.

products.meaning: A & B types, tuples, destructuring lets and tuple patterns.

io.meaning: IO(Unit) mains, IO.bind/IO.die and the pinned file effects in checked core, with a model host.

lists.meaning: List literals [..] as Base Con/Nil, typed from context.

cases.name: nested-self-call
cases.shape: A self-call nested in another self-call's argument, emit(left,emit(right,suffix)), over local types.

knot.justification: Seed-accepted; Knot checks the book and every observed call agrees with both seed lanes.

cases.name: nested-self-call-mistyped
cases.shape: The inner self-call passes a Tree where the suffix is Bits.

knot.justification: A seed type error that no new capability excuses: the checker compares the term against its expected type (existing code type-mismatch).

cases.name: nested-self-call-list
cases.shape: emit(left,emit(right,suffix)) with ByteOutput's own List<&2,U32> chunks and List.append.

knot.justification: Seed-accepted; Knot checks the book and every observed call agrees with both seed lanes.

cases.name: nested-self-call-list-suffix
cases.shape: The inner self-call passes a Tree where the suffix is a list.

knot.justification: A seed type error that no new capability excuses: the checker compares the term against its expected type (existing code type-mismatch).

cases.name: layout-call-args
cases.shape: Newlines after ( and , in call arguments; the last argument call opens a new line.

knot.justification: Seed-accepted; Knot checks the book and every observed call agrees with both seed lanes.

cases.name: layout-call-args-comma
cases.shape: A doubled comma on a call's continuation line.

knot.justification: The seed expects a term at the doubled comma. After a continuation newline is skipped, the parser meets `,` where a term starts: existing code expected-term, reported at that comma.

cases.name: layout-def-header
cases.shape: Multi-line def parameter lists in Knot's shape: trailing comma, continuation indented to the body column, quantity binders on both lines.

knot.justification: Seed-accepted; Knot checks the book and every observed call agrees with both seed lanes.

cases.name: layout-def-header-comma
cases.shape: A doubled comma on a def header's continuation line.

knot.justification: The seed expects a parameter name at the doubled comma. The parameter list parser meets `,` where a binder starts: existing code parameter, reported at that comma.

cases.name: layout-braces
cases.shape: Newlines inside {..}: a constructor split after { and , and a pattern split the same way.

knot.justification: Seed-accepted; Knot checks the book and every observed call agrees with both seed lanes.

cases.name: layout-braces-comma
cases.shape: A doubled comma on a pattern's continuation line.

knot.justification: The seed expects a term at the doubled comma. After a continuation newline is skipped, the parser meets `,` where a term starts: existing code expected-term, reported at that comma.

cases.name: layout-brackets
cases.shape: Newlines inside [..]: a list literal continued after `,`.

knot.justification: Seed-accepted; Knot checks the book and every observed call agrees with both seed lanes.

cases.name: layout-brackets-comma
cases.shape: A doubled comma on a list literal's continuation line.

knot.justification: The seed expects a term at the doubled comma. After a continuation newline is skipped, the parser meets `,` where a term starts: existing code expected-term, reported at that comma.

cases.name: layout-dedent-close
cases.shape: A dedented `name)` line closing a call whose earlier argument spans lines, and a bare dedented `)`.

knot.justification: Seed-accepted; Knot checks the book and every observed call agrees with both seed lanes.

cases.name: layout-dedent-close-extra
cases.shape: The dedented `name)` line closes one call too many.

knot.justification: The seed expects a declaration at the surplus `)`. The body term ends before it: existing code end-of-body, reported at that parenthesis.

cases.name: layout-comments
cases.shape: Blank lines and `#` comment lines inside an open {..}.

knot.justification: Seed-accepted; Knot checks the book and every observed call agrees with both seed lanes.

cases.name: layout-choose-ladder
cases.shape: The dedented choose ladder: after `u =>` the next choose( starts back at the body column.

knot.justification: Seed-accepted; Knot checks the book and every observed call agrees with both seed lanes.

cases.name: layout-choose-ladder-comma
cases.shape: A doubled comma after a thunk in the ladder.

knot.justification: The seed expects a term at the doubled comma. After a continuation newline is skipped, the parser meets `,` where a term starts: existing code expected-term, reported at that comma.

cases.name: fuel-rows
cases.shape: `match fuel mode:` with a `case 0n _` row and `case 1n+ +n K{..}` rows whose predecessor is reused.

knot.justification: Seed-accepted; Knot checks the book and every observed call agrees with both seed lanes.

cases.name: fuel-rows-missing-zero
cases.shape: The dispatcher has no `case 0n _` row.

knot.justification: The seed requires a Zero row. Row coverage is checked per constructor of each column: existing code missing-arm.

cases.name: fuel-wildcard-first
cases.shape: Wildcard-fuel rows first: terminal actions answer before the fuel is inspected.

knot.justification: Seed-accepted; Knot checks the book and every observed call agrees with both seed lanes.

cases.name: fuel-wildcard-first-reuse
cases.shape: A non-reusable predecessor feeds two self-calls.

knot.justification: The seed rejects a second use of a non-reusable binder: existing code affine-reuse.

seed_reason:
- expected : n
- observed : n (consumed more than once)

cases.name: fuel-string-columns
cases.shape: A Nat fuel column beside SNil/SCon columns: `case _ SNil{}` first, then `case 0n SCon{..}` and `case 1n+n SCon{..}`.

knot.justification: Seed-accepted; Knot checks the book and every observed call agrees with both seed lanes.

cases.name: fuel-string-columns-arity
cases.shape: One row names a single pattern for two scrutinees.

knot.justification: The seed expects one pattern per scrutinee. The pattern matrix checks each row's width: code pattern-arity (campaign/nest src/matrix.bend).

cases.name: fuel-continuation
cases.shape: Predecessor self-calls inside continuation lambdas: bind(step(..),next => scan(n,..)) and then(run(n,..),value => run(n,..)).

knot.justification: Seed-accepted; Knot checks the book and every observed call agrees with both seed lanes.

cases.name: fuel-continuation-capture
cases.shape: A continuation reuses a non-reusable predecessor.

knot.justification: The seed rejects a second use of a non-reusable binder: existing code affine-reuse.

seed_reason:
- expected : n
- observed : n (consumed more than once)

cases.name: fuel-four-columns
cases.shape: Four scrutinee columns: fuel, a mode with nested constructor patterns, then catalog and scope columns that rows destructure or skip.

cases.name: fuel-four-columns-column-type

knot.justification: The seed expects a Catalog constructor in that column. A constructor pattern of another type is existing code pattern-type.

cases.name: qualified-nested-ctors

cases.name: qualified-fields-unknown

cases.name: qualified-collision

cases.name: qualified-collision-bare
